# Small, deterministic regression models

These are **synthetic minimized models**, not redistributed original historical
filings and not validation evidence for the named issuers. They make the
NKE-discovered NIL receipt contract, NTAP-style opening-cash conflict, and
bank-style split/continuation layout executable in ordinary CI without private
archives. Source bytes and receipts are pinned in `manifest.json`. The models
were serialized from existing regression builders on 2026-10-29; tests consume
the committed data rather than importing those builders.

The real Microsoft sample remains separately exercised by the PostgreSQL replay
job. Full historical archived-source tests still require authorized originals;
these reduced cases deliberately do not make those tests pretend to pass.
